name: carousel
useFor: Use for a few related items people browse one at a time (merchant cards, screenshots of a checkout). Keep Previous and Next visible; use setApi to show the current slide. Set opts.loop to wrap around and orientation="vertical" for a column.
constraints: Hiding important content in later slides
A carousel for text people must read in full
title: Carousel
description: A row of slides that snap into place, with white keys to step through them.
